name: AimPoint Coordinates
teaser: The mod allows you to view the coordinates of the aiming point, which can be useful for mod development. I originally created it to add spawns to quest items for my quests. However, I believe you can find new uses for it. It is on/off in the f12 menu.
description_html:
The mod allows you to view the coordinates of the aiming point, which can be useful for mod development. I originally created it to add spawns to quest items for my quests. However, I believe you can find new uses for it. It is on/off in the f12 menu. Now you can assign a button for on/off.

Installation:

  1. Unzip the downloaded file.
  2. Drag and drop the BepInEx folder into your root directory.
